propositions: ADR-0083 prescribes isinstance-only capability checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols, which became unsafe on Python 3.12+ because CPython switched to inspect.getattr_static that does not see __getattr__ attributes
A proxy or wrapper transport object with dynamic __getattr__ will fail the isinstance check on Python 3.12+ even though it has the capability, causing silent skipped writes

The tree-wide sweep found exactly one executable isinstance-against-Protocol dispatch site (dispatch_apply_phases.py:188) which is already proxy-hardened with hasattr fallback, and no other affected sites

ADR-0083 guidance text requires amendment to document that isinstance is necessary-but-not-sufficient on 3.12+, prescribe the isinstance + hasattr(obj, member) fallback shape, and cite _capability_present as reference implementation
